message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout during dinner. Instead of panicking, I grabbed our trusty lantern and set it on the table. We lit up the room with some flashlights and even pulled out a portable power bank to keep our phones charged. It turned into a cozy candleless evening, full of laughter and board games by lantern light. Sometimes, embracing the unexpected can turn a little hiccup into a memorable family night! What’s your favorite way to make the best of a power outage?
